section1.p1: Use this service if information shown on your DBS result is incorrect and you want DBS to review it.
section1.p2: You can use this service to dispute:

section2.h2: What happens when you dispute a result

ol.li1: tell us what information is wrong
ol.li2: explain why you believe it is incorrect
ol.li4: provide contact details so we can update you

section2.p2: DBS will review the information and contact you if further details are needed.

section3.h3: Check that the correct DBS check was requested
section3.p1: Do not use this service if you believe the wrong level or type of DBS check was applied for. For example, if an enhanced DBS check was requested for a role that does not qualify.
section3.p2: If you think the wrong DBS check has been carried out, contact the Registered Body or countersignatory who submitted your application. They will be able to advise on the next steps.

section4.p1: If you are disputing your criminal record or convictions, you can upload evidence to support this. For example:

ul.li3: the name and dates of the court you attended

p1.line3: Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm (except public holidays)
